mechanism: Berberine is a potent inhibitor of CYP3A4 and may increase bictegravir concentrations, which is metabolized by CYP3A4; additionally, berberine may inhibit intestinal transporters (P-gp, BCRP) affecting bictegravir absorption.
action: Monitor for bictegravir efficacy and toxicity; consider therapeutic drug monitoring or alternative to berberine if possible; avoid concurrent use without clinical justification.
